sentences.text: Kobe Bean Bryant -LRB- born August 23 , 1978 -RRB- is an American retired professional basketball player and businessman .	basketball	basketball

He played his entire 20-year career with the Los Angeles Lakers of the National Basketball Association -LRB- NBA -RRB- .	Los Angeles Lakers	Los Angeles Lakers	National Basketball Association	National Basketball Association
He entered the NBA directly from high school and won five NBA championships with the Lakers .

Bryant is an 18-time All-Star , 15-time member of the All-NBA Team , and 12-time member of the All-Defensive team .	Team	2007 FIBA Americas Championship	All-Star	NBA All-Star	All-NBA Team	All-NBA Team	All-Defensive team	NBA All-Defensive Team

He led the NBA in scoring during two seasons , and ranks third on the league 's all-time regular season scoring and fourth on the all-time postseason scoring list .	led the NBA in scoring	List of National Basketball Association annual scoring leaders	all-time regular season scoring	List of National Basketball Association career scoring leaders	all-time postseason scoring	List of National Basketball Association career playoff scoring leaders

He holds the NBA record for the most seasons playing with one franchise for an entire career .	most seasons playing with one franchise for an entire career	List of NBA players who have spent their entire career with one franchise

The son of former NBA player Joe Bryant , Kobe Bryant enjoyed a successful high school basketball career at Lower Merion High School in Pennsylvania , where he was recognized as the top high school basketball player in the country .	Lower Merion	Lower Merion High School	basketball	basketball	Joe Bryant	Joe Bryant	Lower Merion High School	Lower Merion High School	Pennsylvania	Pennsylvania

He declared for the NBA draft upon graduation , and was selected with the 13th overall pick in the 1996 NBA draft by the Charlotte Hornets , who traded him to the Lakers .	Charlotte Hornets	1996–97 Charlotte Hornets season	NBA draft	NBA draft	1996 NBA draft	1996 NBA draft

As a rookie , Bryant earned himself a reputation as a high-flyer and a fan favorite by winning the 1997 Slam Dunk Contest , and he was named an All-Star by his second season .	1997	1997 NBA All-Star Game	All-Star	NBA All-Star	Slam Dunk Contest	Slam Dunk Contest

After the Lakers lost the 2004 NBA Finals , O'Neal was traded to the Miami Heat .	2004 NBA Finals	2004 NBA Finals	Miami Heat	Miami Heat

Bryant became the cornerstone of the Lakers , and he led the NBA in scoring during the 2005 -- 06 and 2006 -- 07 seasons .	led the NBA in scoring	List of National Basketball Association annual scoring leaders

In 2006 , he scored a career-high 81 points against the Toronto Raptors , the second most points scored in a single game in league history behind Wilt Chamberlain 's 100-point game in 1962 .	Toronto Raptors	2005–06 Toronto Raptors season	most points scored in a single game	List of National Basketball Association single-game scoring leaders

After losing in the 2008 NBA Finals , he led the Lakers to two consecutive championships in 2009 and 2010 , earning the Finals MVP Award on both occasions .	2009	2009 NBA Finals	2010	2010 NBA Finals	2008 NBA Finals	2008 NBA Finals	Finals MVP Award	Bill Russell NBA Finals Most Valuable Player Award	2008	Basketball at the 2008 Summer Olympics
He continued to be among the top players in the league through 2013 , when the 34-year-old Bryant suffered a torn Achilles tendon .	torn Achilles tendon	torn Achilles tendon
Although he recovered , his play was limited the following two years by season-ending injuries to his knee and shoulder , respectively .
Citing his physical decline , he announced that he would be retiring after the 2015 -- 16 season .
At 34 years and 104 days of age , Bryant became the youngest player in league history to reach 30,000 career points .
He became the all-time leading scorer in Lakers franchise history on February 1 , 2010 , when he surpassed Jerry West .	2010	2010 NBA Finals
